runs.text: Read 6 numbers and show them from smallest to largest, one per line.

hints.text: Sort 5, 3, 8, 1, 9, 2 by hand, picking each time the smallest of those left.
It is the selection program of
For each position from the first, find the smallest of what is left and swap it with the one in that position.
Two nested loops: the outer one walks the positions from 0 to 4; the inner one finds the smallest from the next one. Close with the variant.

runs.text: Show them from largest to smallest by changing a single sign.
Hidden cases: reverse order, repeats and negatives. Frequent mistake: swapping inside the inner loop, which sorts but makes many more swaps.
